thread:
Elena (PM): quick sync — posting the latest mock for the Usage & Billing grid. main questions: where to put the token breakdown, how the account/team toggle behaves, and invoice CTA placement. figma: https://figma.com/s/example (mock v3)
Maya (Design): love the compact rows, but the legend for 'token type' overlaps the sparkline at narrow widths. proposal: move legend to the right and collapse into a tooltip on small screens. :thinking_face:
Ben (Frontend): moving legend right is doable but will impact the table's horizontal scroll. could we instead use an inline icon that opens a popover? less layout shift.
Aldo (Data): also need to think about ordering — most customers want to see compute spend first, then storage, then embeddings. current chart stacks by ingestion order which confuses billing reconciliations.
Sasha (Eng): +1 to Aldo. if we control the series order server-side we can return chart series sorted by our billing priority. frontend can render in that order.
Maya (Design): noted. UX nit: the account vs team toggle label reads 'Account / Workspace' which is inconsistent with other places that use 'Account / Team'. prefer 'Account / Team' for consistency. small copy tweak.
Elena (PM): good catch. also product question — when a user toggles Team, should all charts re-scope immediately or show a warning about data latency (team-level rollups lag ~10m)?
Ben (Frontend): prefer immediate scope + a small inline banner: 'Team data may be delayed by ~10 minutes.' less disruptive than a modal.
Maya (Design): banner idea works. make it subtle: 12px, gray-600, icon :info:. add a tooltip on hover with link to docs.
DesignBot: Figma comment added at frame 12: "legend -> right / collapse for <720px; banner style: subtle-gray-600; tooltip copy: 'Team metrics are updated approximately every 10 minutes.'"
A11y-bot: color-contrast warning on current blue/green palette for the stacked area chart labels — text contrast is 3.8:1 on small labels. Aim for >=4.5:1 for body text.
Maya (Design): thanks — will iterate palette. can we keep the brand blue for tokens but increase saturation on label text?
Sasha (Eng): accessibility first — we can make labels semi-bold and use slightly darker hexes. also suggest adding patterns (diagonal hatch) as an accessibility toggle for colorblind users.
Aldo (Data): regarding token breakdown — customers asked for CSV export of line-items per day. can we add an export button at the top-right of the chart that downloads the series in a flat table?
Ben (Frontend): csv export is fine; will need an API shape: { start, end, granularity, series[] }. Aldo can we standardize column names? CSV should include token_type, model, date, tokens_consumed, cost_usd.
Aldo (Data): yes — that shape works. also include 'project_id' when scoped to Team.
Elena (PM): invoice CTA: current mock has 'Download Invoice' in the top action bar and again on each billing row. is that redundant? thoughts?
Maya (Design): I think global CTA is fine for full account invoices. per-row CTAs useful when billing cycles differ by team/project. maybe show per-row only if invoice_exists=true.
Ben (Frontend): implementation detail — per-row buttons increase DOM count; lazy-render them and hydrate on hover/click.
Sasha (Eng): one risk flagged: the prefix cache indicator in the chart tooltip currently queries the infra for a realtime KV hit rate. that endpoint is heavy. recommend we show cached vs uncached as 'est.' and pull metrics from our pre-aggregated telemetry instead.
Elena (PM): agree — prefer pre-agg. note for release: add a changelog entry under 'Billing' for any tooltip wording changes.
Maya (Design): last: microcopy for the token tooltip — current: 'tokens used by this request'. suggested: 'Estimated tokens used (includes prompt + response); actual invoice may vary due to rounding and model charges.' short and scannable.
A11y-bot: suggested alt text for chart exports: 'Stacked area chart of spend by token type over selected date range'.
Elena (PM): next steps: Maya update figma with legend-to-right variant + accessible palette; Aldo provide CSV spec; Ben prototype banner + popover legend; Sasha verify telemetry endpoint change. I'll collect PRs and aim for a design review next Tue. :calendar:
Maya (Design): on it, will ping when v4 mock is ready. :thumbsup:
Ben (Frontend): starting a branch now — will link a draft PR.
Sasha (Eng): will prepare the telemetry stub.
Aldo (Data): CSV spec posted in #design-docs once finalized.
Elena (PM): thanks team — great session.
